general_translation: Partly for (the purpose of), In addition to, Along with, By the way, And also to, Incidentally, While
formation: Noun + かたがた［する］Verb + かたがた
casual_structure: Noun + かたがた［する］Verb + かたがた
explanation: A formal structure, expressing that (A) is also partly for the purpose of (B). Incidentally to (A), (B). Strong nuance of respect.

example_sentences.japanese: 恩師の訪問：「本日は当時のお礼かたがた、卒業して以来どうしているかをご報告しに訪ねさせていただきました。」
example_sentences.english: Visiting a former teacher: 'Today I visited her to let her know how I have been doing since I graduated, and also to  express my gratitude for that time in my life.'

example_sentences.japanese: 婚約の報告かたがた、お父様とお母様に会いに行きます。
example_sentences.english: I will go see (my partner’s) father and mother, partly for the purpose of letting them know about our engagement.

example_sentences.japanese: 妊娠の報告かたがた、相手の両親の家を訪ねた。
example_sentences.english: I visited my partner’s parents, partly for the purpose of letting them know about the pregnancy.

example_sentences.japanese: お礼かたがた、そちらにお伺いをしたいと思っています。
example_sentences.english: I would like to come visit you, partly for the purpose of thanking you.

example_sentences.japanese: ​​挨拶状：「まずは右ご挨拶かたがたお知らせまで。」
example_sentences.english: Greeting card: For now, this is only a notification and also greetings.

example_sentences.japanese: 結婚の報告かたがた、妻の兄弟の家を訪ねました。
example_sentences.english: I visited my wife's sibling's house partly for the purpose of announcing our marriage.

example_sentences.japanese: 同じ会社で働く上司へのメール：「ご挨拶かたがた訪問をさせて頂きたいのですが、明日のご都合はいかがでしょうか。」
example_sentences.english: Email to a superior in the same company: 'I would like to pay you a visit, partly to say hello. Would tomorrow be convenient for you?'

example_sentences.japanese: ​​同じ会社で働く上司へのメール：「まずはお礼かたがたご挨拶申し上げます。」
example_sentences.english: ​​Email to a superior in the same company: 'For now, I would like to give my greetings, partially to express my gratitude.'

example_sentences.japanese: 恩師の田中先生の家を、お見舞いかたがた訪問しました。
example_sentences.english: I visited the house of my former teacher, Mr. Tanaka, partly to express my heartfelt sympathy.

example_sentences.japanese: 本棚の整理かたがた、春の大掃除をした。
example_sentences.english: I did some spring cleaning, partly for the purpose of cleaning out my bookshelf. (Unnatural Japanese)

grammar_point: を余儀（よぎ）なくさせる
general_translation: Force to, To compel, Make unavoidable
formation: Noun + を余儀（よぎ）なくさせるVerb + こと + を余儀（よぎ）なくさせる
casual_structure: Noun + を余儀（よぎ）なくさせるVerb + こと + を余儀（よぎ）なくさせる
polite_structure: Noun + を余儀（よぎ）なくさせますVerb + こと + を余儀（よぎ）なくさせます
explanation: A phrase implying that someone is being forced to (A). To make it impossible to regard (A) as another problem. Usually a non-human cause.

example_sentences.japanese: 地球温暖化が、サンタクロースに北極点から移転することをよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: Global warming forced Santa Claus to relocate away from the North Pole.

example_sentences.japanese: 外出自粛要請が、飲食店の閉店をよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The official request to refrain from going out forced many eating establishments to close.

example_sentences.japanese: 地元住民からの反対の声が、ショッピングモールの建設の中止をよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The voices of opposition from local residents forced the cancellation of the shopping mall.

example_sentences.japanese: 運転手の不注意が、入院をよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The carelessness of the driver, forced them to get hospitalized.

example_sentences.japanese: パンデミックは店や学校の閉鎖をよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The pandemic forced stores and schools to close.

example_sentences.japanese: 大洪水は都市からの撤退をよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The major flood forced people to withdraw from the city.

example_sentences.japanese: ７０年代のエネルギー危機は政府にガソリン以外の代替エネルギーを探すことをよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The energy crisis of the 1970s forced the government to look for alternative energy sources, other than gasoline.

example_sentences.japanese: バブル崩壊が彼に会社の株式の売却をよぎなくさせた。
example_sentences.english: The economic bubble burst forced him to sell his shares in the company.

example_sentences.japanese: 夏の間の、例年になく少ない降水量は市民に水の消費量を減らすことをよぎなくさせ、水危機意識の向上につながりました。
example_sentences.english: Unusually low precipitation during the summer forced citizens to reduce their water consumption, leading to increased water crisis awareness.

general_translation: Just wait and see, Just you wait, To do a favor, For you, Definitely, For sure
formation: Verb[て] + やる
casual_structure: Verb[て] + やる
polite_structure: Verb[て] + やります
explanation: A casual expression used when doing something for another.

example_sentences.japanese: ​​アクション映画のマッチョな主人公：「ぶっころしてやる！」
example_sentences.english: ​​The macho protagonist in an action movie: 'I'm gonna kill you!'

example_sentences.japanese: 今夜は俺が奢ってやるから、どんどん好きなもん頼めばいいからな。
example_sentences.english: I’m going to pay for you, so don’t hesitate and order whatever you want.

example_sentences.japanese: 絶対綺麗になって見返してやる！
example_sentences.english: I am going to become pretty and prove them wrong, just wait!

example_sentences.japanese: こうなったら勝ってやるしかないだろ。
example_sentences.english: Well, in a situation like this there is no other choice but to win!

example_sentences.japanese: いいよいいよ、俺がやってやるからお前は見とけ。
example_sentences.english: Don’t worry about it, I’ll do it for you, so just watch.

example_sentences.japanese: ​​お金がなくて行きたい大学に行けないという状況：「金持ちになってやる！」
example_sentences.english: ​​The situation of not being able to go to the school one wants to, due to money problems: 'I will get rich, just you wait!'

example_sentences.japanese: ​​低得点で馬鹿にされた後：「絶対、次のテストでは百点取って、あいつをみかえしてやる。」
example_sentences.english: ​​After being ridiculed for a low score: 'I will definitely score 100 on the next test and prove I'm better than that dude, just you wait!'

example_sentences.japanese: 「絶対、合格してやる！」
example_sentences.english: 'I will surely pass, just wait and see!'

example_sentences.japanese: ​​Ａ子：「こっちからあっちまで競走しよ！」 ​​Ｂ子：「いいよ、かってやる!」
example_sentences.english: ​​Child A: 'Let's race from here to there!' ​​Child B: 'Okay! I'll win!'

example_sentences.japanese: ​​アクション映画：「殺せないけどぶちのめしてやる！」
example_sentences.english: ​​Action movie: 'I can't kill you, but I'll beat the living daylights out of you, just you wait!'

example_sentences.japanese: 近づいたら ぶっとばしてやる！
example_sentences.english: 'Get a little close and I will send you flying!'

example_sentences.japanese: いつか真相をあばいてやる！
example_sentences.english: 'One day I will uncover the truth, just you wait!'

example_sentences.japanese: ​​ファンタジー小説、妖怪：「生きたままくってやる！」
example_sentences.english: ​​Fantasy novel, monster: 'I will eat you alive!'

example_sentences.japanese: 「心配しないで！つれていってやる！」
example_sentences.english: 'Don't worry! I will get you out of here!'

general_translation: Nothing but, Should, Have to, Only, All that remains,
formation: (ただ) + Verb［る］+ のみ + (だ(1))(ただ) + ［する］Verb + ある(2) + のみ + (だ(1))(1) である(2) する
casual_structure: (ただ) + Verb［る］+ のみ + (だ(1))(ただ) + ［する］Verb + ある(2) + のみ + (だ(1))(1) である(2) する
polite_structure: (ただ) + Verb［る］+ のみ + (です(1))(ただ) + ［する］Verb + ある(2) + のみ + (です(1))(1) であります(2) する
explanation: An expression used when there is merely just one action remaining.

example_sentences.japanese: Ａ：「どうやれば作家になる夢を実現することができるのでしょう？」 Ｂ：「やっぱりなにごとも練習あるのみだな。」
example_sentences.english: A: 'How can I achieve my dream of becoming a writer?' B: 'In the end, It all rests on practice.'

example_sentences.japanese: 私たちにはもう何もできない。ただ医者を信じて待つのみだ。
example_sentences.english: There is nothing we can do anymore. What we can do is nothing but trust the doctor and wait.

example_sentences.japanese: 僕にできることはただ祈るのみです。
example_sentences.english: I can do nothing but pray.

example_sentences.japanese: 将来日本の大手企業に勤めたいので、ただ勉強あるのみだ。
example_sentences.english: Since I want to work in a big Japanese company in the future, I have no choice but to study.

example_sentences.japanese: 「できるだけのことをした。あとは降伏するのみだ。」
example_sentences.english: 'We have done all we can. All that remains is to surrender.'

example_sentences.japanese: 人生には後悔する暇なんてありません。ただ前進あるのみです。
example_sentences.english: There is no time for something like regrets in life. We have only to move forward.

example_sentences.japanese: テストを受けた後、ただ結果を待つのみだ。
example_sentences.english: 'After taking the test, all that remains is to wait for the results.'

example_sentences.japanese: 「このような状況ではただ前に進んで迎えに行くのみであります。」
example_sentences.english: 'In a situation like this, there is no choice but to keep moving forward.'

example_sentences.japanese: 今戦わなければ死あるのみだ！
example_sentences.english: Nothing but death remains for us if we don't fight now!

example_sentences.japanese: 世界をより良くするためには行動あるのみだ。
example_sentences.english: To make the world a better place, we have no choice but to take action.

example_sentences.japanese: 新聞記者：「アスリートはストレスの多い生活をしているでしょう？」 インタビューされたスポーツマン：「アスリートにとってはスポーツ競技の結果がすべてです。不安もありますが、やるべきことは練習あるのみです。」
example_sentences.english: Newspaper reporter: 'Athletes live a very stressful life, don't they?' Interviewed sportsman: 'For athletes, everything depends on the results of the sports competition. There is anxiety too, but what we have to do we have no choice but to exercise.'

example_sentences.japanese: 週末は仕事の事は考えずに走るのみだね。
example_sentences.english: On weekends I just run, without thinking about work.

example_sentences.japanese: 癖を直すためには、我慢あるのみだ。
example_sentences.english: To cure bad habits, we have no choice but to endure.

example_sentences.japanese: たとえ自分の進む道が難しくなることがあっても、我々は従うのみだ。
example_sentences.english: Even if it happens that our path will get harder, we have no choice but to follow it.

general_translation: Shall, To assume, To suppose, To consider
formation: Verb + ものとする
casual_structure: Verb + ものとする
polite_structure: Verb + ものとします
explanation: An expression for a strong supposition that is treated as a thing that is (A).

example_sentences.japanese: 契約者は、次に掲げる業務を行うものとする。
example_sentences.english: A contractor shall perform the duties listed below.

example_sentences.japanese: 住民税は世帯主が払うものとする。
example_sentences.english: The head of the household shall pay the resident’s tax.

example_sentences.japanese: 契約者の都合で解約をした場合、契約者に解約金を請求するものとする。
example_sentences.english: In the event that the subscription is canceled due to the subscriber’s personal reasons, a termination fee shall be charged to the subscriber.

example_sentences.japanese: ダム建設に対して批判の声が上がったときには、ダム建設を取り下げるものとする。
example_sentences.english: We shall withdraw from building a dam in the event where people oppose it.

example_sentences.japanese: 別表第七に定める帳簿は、五年間保存するものとする。
example_sentences.english: The account books provided in attached table 7 shall be retained for five years.

example_sentences.japanese: 当該研究は、法令の範囲内で行うものとする。
example_sentences.english: The said research shall be conducted within the limits permitted by laws and regulations.

example_sentences.japanese: 延滞金は、納付金に先立つものとする。
example_sentences.english: Penal interest shall be collected prior to the payment.

example_sentences.japanese: 契約書は、英語と日本語をもって記載するものとする。
example_sentences.english: The contract shall be recorded in both English and Japanese.

example_sentences.japanese: 第一条 この法律は、法の適用に関する通則について定めるものとする。
example_sentences.english: Article 1 This Act shall provide for the general rules for the application of laws.

example_sentences.japanese: 取締役会は、毎年度、前項の報告を取りまとめ、その概要を公表するものとする。
example_sentences.english: Each year the board of directors shall compile the reports stated in the preceding paragraph and publicly announce their outline.

example_sentences.japanese: 裁判費用は敗訴当事者が支払うものとする。
example_sentences.english: The losing party shall pay the costs of the trial.

example_sentences.japanese: 応募者は採用通知受領から１４日以内に、就業にあたり求められたすべての書類を提出するものとする。
example_sentences.english: Applicants shall submit all required documents for employment within 14 days of receiving the offer of employment.

example_sentences.japanese: 利用者がこの製品を、当社が意図したとおりに使用しなかったことによって生じた損害や紛争について、当社は一切責任を負わないものとする。
example_sentences.english: The Company shall not be liable for any damages or disputes arising from the user's failure to use this product as intended.

example_sentences.japanese: 会長職および副会長職への就任は、株主総会での承認を経るものとする。
example_sentences.english: The appointment to the positions of chairman and vice chairman shall be subject to approval by the General Meeting of Shareholders.

example_sentences.japanese: 監査役は、常時、すべての文書等を閲覧できるものとする。
example_sentences.english: Auditors shall be authorized to inspect all documents, etc. at any time.

general_translation: That, To
formation: Verb + との + Noun ［い］Adjective + との + Noun ［な］Adjective + (だ) + との + Noun Noun + (だ) + との + Noun
casual_structure: Verb + との + Noun ［い］Adjective + との + Noun ［な］Adjective + (だ) + との + Noun Noun + (だ) + との + Noun
explanation: A combination of two particles, showing that the quoted statement (A) is an attribute belonging to (B).

example_sentences.japanese: 多くの経済学者は、景気が回復しつつあるとの見方を維持した。
example_sentences.english: Many economists maintain the opinion that business conditions are in the process of recovering.

example_sentences.japanese: この周辺で誘拐事件が起きたとの放送があったが、犯人の特徴については放送されなかった。
example_sentences.english: There was an announcement that there was a kidnapping in this area, but the description of the culprit was not mentioned.

example_sentences.japanese: この店はほかの店舗に比べてきたないとのクレームが何件も寄せられているがどうなってるんだい。
example_sentences.english: There was a complaint that this store is dirty compared to the other store, would you mind explaining?

example_sentences.japanese: 本部からこの喫茶店の接客は雑だとの報告を受けました。
example_sentences.english: We have received a report from headquarters, saying that the customer service at this cafe is sloppy.

example_sentences.japanese: ここの先生はヤブ医者との噂を最近聞くけど本当なのだろうか。
example_sentences.english: Recently I have been hearing rumors that he is an unskilled doctor, but I wonder how true that is.

example_sentences.japanese: あの客はクレーマーだとの指摘を先輩から受けたので、あのお客さんを接客するときはいつもより丁寧に接客するつもりだ。
example_sentences.english: My senpai told me that that customer makes a lot of complaints, so I am planning to be extra polite when interacting with them.

example_sentences.japanese: 政府関係者は電気自動車の普及を推進するとの意向を強調した。
example_sentences.english: The government officials stressed that their intention was to promote the popularization of electric vehicles.

example_sentences.japanese: 田中さんは新しい反トラスト法が抜け穴だらけとの意見を表明した。
example_sentences.english: Mr. Tanaka made clear his view that the new antitrust law is full of loopholes.

example_sentences.japanese: 探偵の伝記：「２００２年、彼は、南アフリカに連れて行った男性の家出人を探してほしいとの依頼を受けた。」
example_sentences.english: The biography of a detective: 'In 2002, he received a request to find a runaway man that went to South Africa.'

example_sentences.japanese: あの日、 雪崩が発生したとの報告もあったが、けが人が出ているかどうかは確認されていなかった。
example_sentences.english: That day there was also a report that an avalanche had occurred, but it was not clear whether any injured people had appeared.

example_sentences.japanese: ７月１日、Ａ会社からはＢ会社と合併に向けた交渉を続けていく、との報告を受けた。
example_sentences.english: On July 1, a report from company A was received that they were in the process of negotiations toward a merger with company B.

example_sentences.japanese: 財務大臣は金融市場が落ち着きを取り戻すとの見解を明らかにした。
example_sentences.english: The Minister of finance expressed an opinion that the financial markets will regain stability.

example_sentences.japanese: 専門家は閉鎖空間内での喫煙が禁止されるべきであるとの提案書を出した。
example_sentences.english: Experts submitted a proposal calling for smoking to be banned in all enclosed spaces.

example_sentences.japanese: 焦点になっているのは、環境基準を導入する作業を開始するとの提案だ。
example_sentences.english: The focus of the proposal is to start work on introducing environmental standards.

example_sentences.japanese: 総理大臣からは、税の一部は廃止すべきとの考えが示された。
example_sentences.english: The Prime minister presented the opinion that some taxes should be abolished.

example_sentences.japanese: 年々、看護師の人数が減少の傾向にあるとの指摘をよく聞きます。
example_sentences.english: It is often pointed out that the number of nurses tends to lower year by year.

example_sentences.japanese: 取材に応じた田中会長は、ストライキ参加者の要求を受け入れるかとの質問に対して、２月の取締役会における議題となるでしょう、と語った。
example_sentences.english: When asked the question of whether he would accept the demands of the strikers, Mr. Tanaka, the chairman of the board of directors, responded that it will be on the agenda for the board of directors meeting in February.

general_translation: Before, Not even, Before even, Precede, Far from
formation: Noun(1) + 以前（いぜん）（に）  Noun(1) (A) + 以前（いぜん） + の + Noun (B)  (1) A(2) + (Antonym) A(2), Verb (A) + Verb (A)［ない］(2)  (2) ［な］Adjective、［い］Adjective
casual_structure: Noun(1) + 以前（いぜん）（に）  Noun(1) (A) + 以前（いぜん） + の + Noun (B)  (1) A(2) + (Antonym) A(2), Verb (A) + Verb (A)［ない］(2)  (2) ［な］Adjective、［い］Adjective
explanation: An emphatic suffix meaning before, often used critically. Prior to something like (A), (B).

example_sentences.japanese: ポイ捨ては法律いぜんの道義的な問題だ。
example_sentences.english: When it comes to littering, before even the law, it is a moral issue.

example_sentences.japanese: それは古いか新しいかいぜんの問題だと思う。
example_sentences.english: I think that is a problem before worrying about whether it is new or old.

example_sentences.japanese: 人のことを心配するいぜんに自分の心配をしろ！
example_sentences.english: Before worrying about others, worry about yourself!

example_sentences.japanese: 安全か危険かいぜんに、それは法律で禁じられているので試すこともできません。
example_sentences.english: Before whether it is safe or dangerous, that is forbidden by law, so you will not even be able to try it.

example_sentences.japanese: お前が結婚できないのは顔いぜんの問題だよ。お前は性格が悪すぎる。
example_sentences.english: Your face is far from the reason you cannot get married. You have a bad personality.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は、自分が女の子にモテないのはファッションがださいからだと思ってる。それは事実だけど、それいぜんの問題として、彼は性格に問題がある。
example_sentences.english: He believes that he is not popular with girls due to his bad fashion sense. While that is true, even before that, he has issues with his personality.

example_sentences.japanese: 信じる信じないいぜんにもっと根本的な問題なんだよ。先ずどうにか彼女にこの事を伝えなきゃ。
example_sentences.english: Before whether she believes it or not, there is a more fundamental issue. To start, I must somehow convey this to her.

example_sentences.japanese: 食べずに「ブロッコリーが嫌い」という人もいます。好き嫌いいぜんに、食べてみることが大事なのです。食べた上で、好き嫌いはご自由に。
example_sentences.english: There are even people who say 'I don't like brocolli', without having eaten it. Before being nitpicky, what's important is to try it. Upon eating it, then feel free to be fussy.

example_sentences.japanese: パフォーマンスいぜんの問題で、基本的な機能を実装する必要があります。
example_sentences.english: Preceding the performance issue, it is necessary to equip it with basic functionality.

example_sentences.japanese: Ａ：「結婚式でクラゲのようなウェディングドレスを着たいわ。」Ｂ：「それいぜんに先ずは交際を始めたら？」
example_sentences.english: A: 'I want to wear a wedding dress that looks like jellyfish at my wedding.' B: 'Before that, how about starting to date first?'

example_sentences.japanese: 勉強の欲望を持っているかどうかは能力いぜんの問題だ。
example_sentences.english: Whether or not someone has a desire to study precedes the matter of learning ability.

example_sentences.japanese: 上司が部下に：「間違いは修正し終わったとあなたはいつも言うが、それいぜんに、なぜその間違いをするのかを考えるほうが重要だよ。」
example_sentences.english: Boss to the subordinate: 'You always say that you are done correcting your mistakes, but before that, it is more important to think about why you make those mistakes.'

example_sentences.japanese: Ａ：「彼女が来るかどうか心配だよ」 Ｂ：「くる来ないいぜんにまず誘ってみてね。」
example_sentences.english: A: 'I am worried that she won't come.' B: 'Before worrying about whether she comes or not you should try inviting her first.'

example_sentences.japanese: 行動しない人には何も始まらない。できるできないいぜんにまずは行動することが必要である。
example_sentences.english: Nothing starts for people who do not act. First of all, it is necessary to take action, before worrying about being able to do it or not.

example_sentences.japanese: Ａ：「なんで海に行きたくないんだ？海、嫌い？」 Ｂ：「興味がないから好き嫌いいぜんの話。」
example_sentences.english: A: 'Why don't you want to go to the sea? You dislike it?' B: 'Before any preferences, I simply am not interested.'

example_sentences.japanese: かわいそうな野猫をみる時、かえで：「この猫、小さくてかわいいし、めっちゃ飼いたい！」 かなこ：「それいぜんに賃貸アパートで動物を飼ってもいいのか？」
example_sentences.english: Seeing a poor, stray cat, Kaede: 'This cat is so cute and small, I want to keep it so badly!' Kanako: 'Before that, can I have an animal in my rented apartment?'

general_translation: Of all people, Such,
formation: Noun + ともあろう + もの(1) + が  (1) 方（かた）、人（ひと）
casual_structure: Noun + ともあろう + もの(1) + が  (1) 方（かた）、人（ひと）
explanation: An expression meaning that even being (A), something surprising is true of someone or some organization.

example_sentences.japanese: この田中さんともあろうものがくだらないミスをしてしまった。
example_sentences.english: For Mr. Tanaka of all people to make such a silly mistake.

example_sentences.japanese: 有名な大学の教授ともあろう人が、ろくに敬語も使えないなんておかしい。
example_sentences.english: Of all people, it is strange that a professor of a famous university cannot even use keigo properly.

example_sentences.japanese: 教会の牧師さんともあろうお方が、詐欺で逮捕されるなんてショックすぎる。
example_sentences.english: I am so shocked that the pastor of a church of all people was arrested for fraud.

example_sentences.japanese: 警察ともあろうものが違法薬物を使用していたなんて信じられない。
example_sentences.english: I can’t believe that a police officer of all people was using an illegal substance.

example_sentences.japanese: 大自然を保護することを呼びかけている国会議員ともあろうものが、砂浜にごみを散らかすとは信じられない。
example_sentences.english: Of all people, It is unbelievable that a member of the Diet who calls for the protection of nature would litter at the beach.

example_sentences.japanese: 乱世の時にこんなふざけた言動があるだろうか。議員ともあろうものが…
example_sentences.english: A joke like this in such turbulent times? And from a member of parliament of all people…

example_sentences.japanese: 上司が部下坂本に：「君ともあろう優秀な部下がこんなミスをするなんて。なぜあんなことを？」
example_sentences.english: Superior to his subordinate, Sakamoto: 'I cannot believe that of all people, a brilliant subordinate such as you would make this kind of mistake. Why did you do such a thing?'

example_sentences.japanese: ファンタジー映画：「 賢いウィザードともあろう者がいつ正気を失った？」
example_sentences.english: Fantasy movie: 'When did the wise wizard of all people lose all sanity?'

example_sentences.japanese: 高橋さんともあろうお方がこんな簡単なことができないなんて、珍しいですね。
example_sentences.english: Takahashi-san, it is so rare that a person such as yourself can’t do something so simple. (Sarcastic)

general_translation: And certainly not, But certainly not, But, Although, Even though
formation: ［する］Verb + こそすれVerb［stem］+ こそすれ
casual_structure: ［する］Verb + こそすれVerb［stem］+ こそすれ
explanation: An expression made up of an adverbial particle and a classical verb form, used to emphatically say that (A) is true while (B) certainly is not.

example_sentences.japanese: セキュリティ事故はふえこそすれ、減りはしないだろう。
example_sentences.english: The security incidents will only increase, certainly not decrease.

example_sentences.japanese: このままだと日本の経済は悪化こそすれ、回復はしないだろう。
example_sentences.english: At this rate, Japan's economy will continue to worsen, and certainly not recover.

example_sentences.japanese: あのカードは世界に一枚しかないので値段が上がりこそすれ、下がりはしないだろう。
example_sentences.english: That is the only card that exists in this world, so the price will keep rising, and certainly not decrease.

example_sentences.japanese: 運動は健康のためにこそなれ、絶対に損にはならない。
example_sentences.english: Exercise will be beneficial for your health, and you certainly won’t regret it.

example_sentences.japanese: それは損にこそなれ、利益になることはないだろう。
example_sentences.english: That would be a loss, and certainly won’t be profitable.

example_sentences.japanese: 憎みこそあれ、実際に傷つけようとは思ったこともない。
example_sentences.english: I have felt hatred towards you, but I certainly have never thought of actually hurting you.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼はコミュニケーションの能力こそあれ、仕事は得意ではない。
example_sentences.english: He has skill in communication, but he certainly is not a skilled worker.

example_sentences.japanese: 小説：「だが実際は、剣士の復讐心は火の手をつよめこそすれ、決して冷めるどころではなかったのである。」
example_sentences.english: Novel: 'In reality, however, the swordsman's blazing desire for vengeance was intensifying, and certainly not cooling down at all.'

example_sentences.japanese: 多くの人にとって、その奇妙な現象はおどろきこそすれ、恐怖を感じるほどではなかった。
example_sentences.english: The strange phenomenon was surprising for many, and certainly not terrifying.

example_sentences.japanese: 魔法使いへの恋情は、つよめこそすれ弱めるものではなかった。
example_sentences.english: Her love for the sorcerer strengthened, and certainly didn't weaken.

example_sentences.japanese: かんしゃこそすれ、憎しみを感じるなんてちゃんちゃらおかしいよ。
example_sentences.english: I feel gratitude, certainly not something as ridiculous as hatred.

example_sentences.japanese: 武田さんに敬意をはらいこそすれ嘲弄する気持ちなど一切ない。
example_sentences.english: I am respectful of Mr. Takeda, and certainly have no desire to mock him at all.

example_sentences.japanese: 感謝されこそすれ、文句を言われる筋合いはない。
example_sentences.english: I should be thanked, you certainly are not in the position to complain.

general_translation: As, On par with, Worthy of
formation: Noun + 並（な）み + だNoun + 並（な）み + の + NounNoun + 並（な）み + に + Phrase
casual_structure: Noun + 並（な）み + だNoun + 並（な）み + の + NounNoun + 並（な）み + に + Phrase
polite_structure: Noun + 並（な）み + ですNoun + 並（な）み + の + NounNoun + 並（な）み + に + Phrase

example_sentences.japanese: 私の妻の歌はプロなみだ。
example_sentences.english: My wife's singing is on par with pros.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は日本語をネイティブなみに話せるから、彼がいると安心できる。
example_sentences.english: He can speak Japanese as well as a native, so I feel at ease when he is around.

example_sentences.japanese: あの子のサーブの仕方はプロなみだ。
example_sentences.english: Their serve is on par with pros.

example_sentences.japanese: まだ５月なのに８月なみの暑さだ。
example_sentences.english: Despite it still being May, it is as hot as August.

example_sentences.japanese: アトランタの年間日照時間は、ローマ平均なみである。
example_sentences.english: Atlanta's annual daylight hours are on par with Rome's average.

example_sentences.japanese: チタンは鋼鉄なみの丈夫さだが、はるかに軽量である。
example_sentences.english: Titanium is as strong as steel, yet much lighter.

example_sentences.japanese: この映画はアカデミー賞なみの功績でした。
example_sentences.english: This movie was an achievement on par with the level of an academy award.

example_sentences.japanese: 統計から推測すると、中国の経済は先進国なみになってきている。
example_sentences.english: Statistics suggest that China's economy has come to be on par with that of other developed countries.

example_sentences.japanese: 現代人は、２０年前のスーパーコンピュータなみのスマホというデバイスをポケットに入れている。
example_sentences.english: Modern people carry in their pockets devices known as smartphones, that are on par with supercomputers 20 years ago.

example_sentences.japanese: あのような家は並の人には高すぎます。
example_sentences.english: A house like that is too expensive for the average person.

example_sentences.japanese: 並の大学生がお金を貯めるにはアルバイトだけではなく、節約できるところで節約もしないといけません。
example_sentences.english: In order for the average college student to save money, not only do they have to work part-time, but they also have to cut expenses where they can.

example_sentences.japanese: この子供の柔軟さはトカゲ並みのレベルがありそうです。
example_sentences.english: It seems that this kid’s flexibility is on par with that of a lizard. (Unnatural Japanese, as the flexibility of a lizard is not something that is either easy to imagine, or common knowledge)

general_translation: First, Prior to, Pioneer, Ahead of
formation: Noun + に先駆（さきが）け（て）
casual_structure: Noun + に先駆（さきが）け（て）
explanation: An expression used to show that someone leads the charge, doing something before others.

example_sentences.japanese: １７６３年に、プロイセンは他国にさきがけて近代的な義務教育を導入した。
example_sentences.english: In 1763, paving the way for other countries, Prussia introduced the modern compulsory education.

example_sentences.japanese: 世界にさきがけ、あの国は死刑を廃止した。
example_sentences.english: Pioneering for other countries, that country was the first to abolish the death penalty.

example_sentences.japanese: 三重県は全国にさきがけ、梅雨入りをした。
example_sentences.english: Ahead of the rest of the nation, the rainy season kicked off in Mie prefecture.

example_sentences.japanese: Ａ社は他社にさきがけて、自動運転が可能な車を開発した。
example_sentences.english: Paving the way for other companies, Company A developed a self-driving automobile.

example_sentences.japanese: コンサートのサイト：「ファンクラブでは、一般発売にさきがけて、チケットの販売を行います。」
example_sentences.english: Concert website: 'The selling of tickets via the fan club will take place prior to offering them to the general public.'

example_sentences.japanese: 広告：「世界の人々にさきがけて、楽しみながら学ぶ体験型博物館を訪れてみてはいかがでしょう。」
example_sentences.english: Advertisement: 'Why not be among the first in the world to visit a hands-on museum where you can learn while having fun?'

example_sentences.japanese: 我が社は他社にさきがけて世界初となる海流発電の実証実験を成功させた。
example_sentences.english: Pioneering for other companies, our company was the first in the world to succeed in demonstrating ocean current power generation.

example_sentences.japanese: スプートニク１号は世界にさきがけて打ち上げられた人工衛星です。
example_sentences.english: Pioneering for the rest of the world, Sputnik was the first artificial satellite to be launched.

example_sentences.japanese: 京都市は全国にさきがけて省エネ活動に取り組んでいます。
example_sentences.english: Ahead of the rest of the country, the city of Kyoto was the first to engage in Energy Conservation Activities.

general_translation: Opportunity, Occasion
formation: Verb + の + を機（き）に（して）Noun + を機（き）に（して）
casual_structure: Verb + の + を機（き）に（して）Noun + を機（き）に（して）
explanation: An expression meaning an opportunity is actively made of a specific event, or that (A) is the mechanism for achieving it.

example_sentences.japanese: 小説：「３ヶ月目にやっと病気が完治し、これをきに、入院後初めて退院することができた。」
example_sentences.english: Novel: 'In the third month, she was finally completely cured of her illness, and this opportunity allowed her to leave the hospital for the first time since hospitalization.'

example_sentences.japanese: 妻の妊娠をきにタバコを止めることにした。
example_sentences.english: Taking advantage of the time of my wife’s pregnancy, I have decided to quit smoking.

example_sentences.japanese: 車検をきに、新しい車を買うことにした。
example_sentences.english: On the occasion of my car inspection, I have decided to buy a new car. (Due to being told that the current car is probably beyond repair)

example_sentences.japanese: 彼氏と別れたのをきに、新しいバッグを買った。
example_sentences.english: Making the most of the breakup with my boyfriend, I bought a new bag. (In order to feel new and fresh)

example_sentences.japanese: ７年間使っていた携帯がとうとう壊れた。これをきに機種変更することにした。
example_sentences.english: My cell phone, which I had been using for 7 years, finally broke. I decided to take this opportunity to change the model.

example_sentences.japanese: 伝記：「大学卒業をきに大阪へ移り、プログラミングの職を得ることができました。」
example_sentences.english: Biography: 'On the opportunity of graduation, I moved to Osaka and was able to land a programming job.'

example_sentences.japanese: 演説：「今回の訪問をきに、より多くのアメリカ人が日本で働くことに興味を持つことを願っています。」
example_sentences.english: Speech: 'We hope that this visit will provide an opportunity for more Americans to be interested in working in Japan.'

example_sentences.japanese: 小説：「結婚をきにたまひこは東京を離れ、千葉の町でゆずきとふたりの新生活を始じめた。」
example_sentences.english: Novel: 'On the opportunity of getting married, Tamahiko left Tokyo and started a new life with Yuzuki in the town of Chiba.'

example_sentences.japanese: 伝記：「ひろしは５６歳の時故郷へ戻ったのをきに、両親の墓参りに行った。」
example_sentences.english: Biography: 'When Hiroshi returned to his hometown at the age of 56, he took the opportunity to visit his parent's graves.'

example_sentences.japanese: この橋はアニメのエピソードに登場したことで有名になった。これをきに、近隣からだけでなく全国から、大勢の人が訪れるようになった。
example_sentences.english: This bridge became famous when it appeared in an episode of an anime. This opportunity led to a large number of visitors, not only from surrounding areas, but from all over the country.
